blk_part_01_part_1_three_ways_of_learnin.text: Upskilling means getting better at your current job. You add new skills so that you can do the same work in a stronger way. Reskilling means learning skills for a different job or role. Lifelong learning is the bigger idea behind both. It means you keep learning for your whole life, not only at school.
